Android - device shell
A complete shell for your Android device.
Home screen, media, streams, apps, watch and files - all in one place.

Fast Media Sorter & Organizer takes over the home screen and becomes the place everything starts from: device shell, media player, live streams, app launching, a replacement for stock apps, a companion on the watch, device monitoring and a full file manager for local storage, SMB/NAS, SFTP/FTP and cloud drives.
Get started
Open your first folder
The safe first result is simply viewing a local folder. Files do not change until you choose Copy or Move.
Google Play GitHub Releases IzzyOnDroid
Install a suitable edition and open the app.
Allow file access if Android requests it.
Tap Add resource, choose a local folder, and review its contents before sorting.
Important
File access is required for sorting. Review your selection before moving; use Copy first when reversibility matters.
Full feature catalogue
Replaces More Than a Dozen Apps

Fast Media Sorter combines a media browser, viewer, player, file manager and organizer. Instead of separate apps for video, music, galleries, reading, network folders, cloud storage and everyday file work, you use one collection with one familiar set of actions. The apps below are only recognizable reference points for the capabilities, not a comparison ranking.
Viewing & Playback
Video player (MX Player, VLC) - video, Blu-ray TS/.m2ts, picture-in-picture, frame screenshots, Chromecast casting.
Audio player (Poweramp, AIMP) - background playback, lyrics, MIDI, sleep timer, visualizations, notification controls.
Gallery / image viewer (QuickPic, Google Photos) - images and GIFs, crop, filters, rotate.
PDF / EPUB reader (Adobe Reader, Moon+ Reader) - books, chapter maps, themes, Read Aloud (TTS).
Slideshow / photo frame - rotating photos with background music, plus a photo-frame widget.
TV media center (Kodi, Nova Video Player) - D-pad, keyboard, mouse, gamepad, and TV-remote-friendly browsing and playback.
VR media player (Pigasus, Skybox VR) - stereo SBS/OU, VR180, 360°, virtual cinema screen. VR edition

Internet radio / IPTV player (TuneIn, Online Radio, RadioDroid, VLC network) - Streams screen plays http/https radio, HLS/DASH, and RTSP sources; inline mini-player with ICY now-playing; curated station catalog.
Capture & Create
Camera (stock camera) - photo and video straight to a chosen local, network, or cloud folder.
Voice recorder - voice notes plus a quick-record widget.
Drawing editor - canvas, brushes, shapes, text, custom brush color and size.
Document / text scanner (Google Lens, CamScanner) - on-device OCR from the camera with area crop.
File Management
File manager (Total Commander, ES File Explorer, Files by Google) - local, network, and cloud files in one place.
FTP/SFTP/SMB client (AndFTP, Solid Explorer) - network sources with SSH keys and host-key pinning.
Cloud clients (Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive) - cloud drives as media sources.
Duplicate finder (Duplicate Files Fixer) - 3-phase Size -> Hash -> SHA-256 engine.
Recycle bin (Dumpster) - soft delete with one-tap restore.
Archive extractor (ZArchiver) - ZIP extraction, including password-protected. basic
Download manager (1DM, ADM) - paste a link and save directly to a chosen folder.
Task scheduler - scheduled file operations.
Text & Utilities
Text / Markdown editor - edit .txt/.md with syntax highlighting and auto-save.
Translator (Google Translate offline) - fully offline translation.
Calculator - built-in evaluation of expressions from selected text. basic
Cast to TV (Google Home) - Chromecast for both video and audio.
Home-screen widget pack - quick-launch and status widgets for recorder, camera OCR, scheduled tasks, now playing, and photo frame.
Settings backup tool - export and restore app setup, sources, favorites, schedules, passwords, and sign-ins. app setup only

Honesty notes: the calculator and archiver are basic (evaluate-from-text / ZIP extraction), not full replacements. Settings backup covers the app's own setup, not full-device backup. The VR player is VR-edition only.
Usage Scenarios
Each block starts with a quick answer and opens into practical detail when you need the setup path.
Digital Photo Frame
Standard / VR
Turn an Android tablet into an always-on frame that streams photos from SMB/NAS or cloud without filling local storage.
Details
Add a photo source from SMB/NAS, local storage, or cloud.
Enable slideshow intervals and optional background music.
Use an old tablet, TV box, or desk device as the display.
Open recipe
In-Car Music
Standard OnlyLegacy
Use an Android head unit as a focused music player for local, USB, or network libraries.
Create or open an audio resource for the full collection.
Keep playback alive through the background audio service.
Use large controls, steering-wheel buttons, and notification playback controls where supported.
Open recipe
Internet Radio & Streams
Standard / Legacy
Use Fast Media Sorter as your internet-radio and IPTV player - add station URLs, import .m3u playlists, or download the curated catalog and play while driving.
Enable Streams in Settings > Media > Streams or from the main menu.
Add a station URL manually or import a .m3u playlist from a URL.
Download the curated Fast Media Sorter catalog for ready-made stations with topic and language tags.
Radio plays inline with a sticky now-playing bar; video/RTSP opens fullscreen.
Open recipe
Home Cinema & VR
Watch films and series from a PC, NAS, or cloud on phone, TV box, or VR headset without copying files first.
Connect the video library over SMB, SFTP, FTP, local storage, or cloud.
Use session restore and auto-advance for serial playback.
Open supported 3D and 360° media in flat mode or the VR edition.
Open recipe
Download Organizer
All editions
Clear a messy Downloads folder by sending files to prepared destinations in one tap.
Create destination buttons for work, photos, archives, music, and temp files.
Use copy or move depending on how much risk you want.
Undo protects the last operation when a file lands in the wrong place.
Open recipe
Scheduled Camera Backup
Standard
Copy new camera photos and videos to a PC or NAS over Wi-Fi during night charging.
Use SMB as the destination and choose the camera folder as the source.
Set skip-existing copy mode to avoid duplicate uploads.
Run it on a schedule that matches Wi-Fi and charging availability.
Open recipe
SMB Network Setup
Connect Android devices to a Windows, macOS, Linux, or NAS shared folder over the local network.
Share the folder on the computer or NAS and keep both devices on one Wi-Fi network.
Use network scan when possible, or enter the IP address manually.
Run Test Connection before using the resource in daily workflows.
Open recipe
Windows Folder Share (PC Companion)
Standard / Photos / Legacy
Share a folder from a Windows PC straight to the app: the free Fast Media Sorter for Windows runs a secure SFTP server for it - pairing is one imported config file, no manual host/port/key entry.
Install Fast Media Sorter for Windows on the PC: GitHub release, winget install SerZhyAle.FastMediaSorter, or "FastMediaSorter LITE" in Microsoft Store (published under its former name).
Pick the folders to share on the PC - server, keys and autostart are set up automatically.
On the phone: Add resource > SFTP/FTP > Import from companion, then open the exported .fmscfg file.
Step-by-step PC guide: How to publish folders for Android.
Get Fast Media Sorter for Windows
Offline Travel Folder
Prepare one local folder with media, PDFs, EPUBs, screenshots, and notes before unreliable internet starts.
Copy the travel set while Wi-Fi is stable.
Open the folder once to warm thumbnails and remembered positions.
Use filters to jump between documents, images, audio, and video offline.
Open recipe
Cloud Documents & EPUB
Standard for cloudAll editions locally
Read PDFs and EPUBs from cloud storage or local folders with reader-friendly controls.
Open Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, or a local document folder.
Use PDF themes, EPUB formatting, and reading-position restore.
Send niche formats to specialist apps when Android has a better viewer.
Open recipe
OCR Translation
Extract and translate text from images, scans, screenshots, and PDFs without leaving the viewer.
Open an image, PDF, or text file and run Translate/OCR.
Use ML Kit for fast recognition and Tesseract models when quality matters.
Review the translated overlay directly on the original content.
Open recipe
NAS Media Shelf for TV
StandardLite / Photos
Use a NAS as the shared media shelf for an Android TV box, tablet, or living-room phone.
Create one SMB resource for family media and split it into clear subfolders.
Use network speed checks when streaming feels slow.
Pair a remote, keyboard, or gamepad for couch navigation.
Open recipe
Duplicate Cleanup
Find identical files across storage before a photo archive or download folder grows out of control.
Scan by size, partial hash, and full SHA-256 to avoid risky name-only matching.
Review matches before removal, or use auto-delete for trusted sets.
Use it after imports, backups, and manual folder merges.
Open recipe
Chromecast Playback
Standard / Lite / Legacy
Send audio, images, and local video from the phone to a Cast receiver in the room.
Use a Cast-compatible receiver on the same network.
Stream local media and supported audio/image sessions directly.
Keep VR separate: Cast support depends on Google Play Services on the device.
Open recipe
Home-Screen Smart Widgets
Standard / Legacy / VR
Add one-tap shortcuts to your home screen to record voice notes, scan documents, or run background sync tasks.
Place a voice recorder widget to save audio notes directly to a NAS.
Set up a random photo widget for an home-screen slideshow.
Monitor background copy or sync queues with active widgets.
Open recipe
Home Screen Replacement (Launcher)
Standard Only
Replace your device's home screen with the app's own desktop - your folders, a clock, the weather, your apps and a taskbar, arranged the way you want.
Turn an old tablet into a wall panel showing the clock, the weather and your NAS photo folder.
Place folders, gadgets, contacts and app shortcuts on a desktop that keeps portrait and landscape apart.
Use the Start menu and the taskbar for recent and pinned apps, and leave launcher mode whenever you want.
Open recipe
OpenXR VR Immersive Cinema
VR Only
Watch SBS 3D movies, 360°/180° videos, or flat files on a massive virtual screen in virtual reality.
Switch to immersive 3D/360° per-eye rendering with the VR Badge.
Control menus with Quest Hand Tracking gestures or aiming rays.
Capture stereoscopic snapshots and mixed-reality screenshots.
Open recipe
Quick Math & Calculations
Select mathematical equations or numbers within PDFs, books, or OCR overlays to evaluate them instantly.
Highlight a formula like (45 + 12) * 3 inside any viewer.
Open the scientific calculator directly from the selection menu.
Save history and memory slots (M+/M-) between sessions.
Open recipe
Cloud Markdown & Code Notes
Create and edit Markdown files or code snippets directly on cloud folders, local storage, or network shares.
Use the built-in syntax-highlighted Markdown editor.
Create new notes directly on NAS (SMB) or Google Drive.
Render Markdown, resolve naming conflicts, and export files.
Open recipe
Music on Smartwatch
Wear OS (FastMedia Wear)
Browse and play music directly on your Wear OS watch with album art, shuffle, bezel volume, and battery-saving screen-off mode.
Stream audio tracks from your paired Android phone or play local watch storage.
Control playback with rotary crown/bezel volume and draggable touch seekbar.
OLED screen-off mode powers off display pixels while playback continues.
Open recipe Wear OS Web Portal
Connect Watch to Network Shares
Connect your smartwatch directly to NAS, Windows shares, FTP, or SFTP servers over Wi-Fi for standalone browsing and playback.
Direct Wi-Fi connection to SMB, FTP, and SFTP (password or SSH private key).
Test connection status directly on your wrist before saving.
One-tap sync from phone companion to import all existing shares.
